items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: He and Roy were in Horace Henderson's band together.

ctx.x: He certainly was a very good drummer. He was one of the great ones. I don't know how he got out of the business or why he got out. He was really good.
And you said that Bernise blew horn with Roy (Eldridge) too, you said, didn't you?
Yeah. He and Roy were in Horace Henderson's band together.
